mostWorthwhile.text: Getting the radio working was most worthwhile: the twelve-minute-old message made the distance from Earth tangible and gave me a reason to wonder what happens next.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and installing the window quilt involved several predictable steps; the final detail was evocative, but assembling it held few surprises.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the cabin also had a supplied fuel-cell backup for essential systems during a dark spell.

arbitrary.text: Charging the battery had a plausible purpose, although its role in completing nighttime preparation was not clear until the result.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to hear the reply from Earth and see how the expedition develops, although I would hope for more decisions with less predictable outcomes.
